description.value: This study investigated differences in the relationship between trait impulsivity and cortical thickness in Internet addicts, smokers, and healthy controls.

spans.text: Thus, we test whether the cortical correlates of trait impulsivity are different in Internet addicts and healthy controls, using an impulsive control group (smokers).
